message: Installer still discovers VolumeType*.MyDc files while runtime BAT and MyD scripts now read VolumeType*.txt files.
suggestedFix: Choose one volume-role file extension and update installer discovery, SaveDriveRoles writes, GetVolumeTypeFromName suffix stripping, shipped files, BAT wrappers, and MyD includes consistently.

message: The SKIP branch redirects to "%OutputFile%"F, which creates or targets the wrong path instead of the intended .txt volume-type file.
suggestedFix: Remove the stray F so the command writes exactly to "%OutputFile%".

message: The per-drive wrapper reads VolumeName, then compares an empty literal string to SKIP, so configured SKIP roles are never skipped. The same pattern exists in DriveD.bat through DriveG.bat.
suggestedFix: Compare !VolumeName! to SKIP, and apply the same fix to all ScriptsByDrive and ResetScripts/ScriptsByDrive wrappers.

message: AllDaily.bat has IF statements with no command body on the same line or parenthesized block. Sys/Data/Archive execution is not guarded as intended, and Dev has no call at all.
suggestedFix: Use the same parenthesized IF blocks used by AllWeekly/AllMonthly/AllYearly, and call DevDaily.bat in the Dev section.

message: When -IncIncludeLine is set, the include handler decrements the for-loop index after processing an include. The next loop iteration reprocesses the same include line, causing an unbounded loop or repeated expansion.
suggestedFix: Do not mutate $i. Track a separate displayed source-line number if include directives should not consume source numbering.

message: Start-menu shortcuts point to ScriptDaily, ScriptWeekly, ScriptMonthly, and ScriptYearly, but the repository uses ScriptsDaily, ScriptsWeekly, ScriptsMonthly, and ScriptsYearly.
suggestedFix: Update shortcut targets to the plural directory names, or rename/copy directories during installation so shortcuts resolve.

message: The language contribution registers .mydfrg and .mdf, but the Taylor2 codebase is built around .MyD, .MyDc, .MyDs, and .MyDx fragments. Editor diagnostics will not attach to the primary project files through this manifest.
suggestedFix: Register the actual Taylor2/MyDefrag extensions, or document that this manifest is not the active VSCodium extension manifest.

message: CheckSSD.bat prints intermediate normalization states on every run, which makes scheduler and wrapper logs noisy and harder to diagnose.
suggestedFix: Gate normalization traces behind a debug flag or remove the temporary echo statements after validation.

message: The user instructions require loading .AI/SESSION_TEMPLATE.md before work, but the file is absent from the current checkout.
suggestedFix: Add .AI/SESSION_TEMPLATE.md or update AGENTS.md/project instructions to point at the current prompt-loading entry point.
